_note: Single source of truth for the standing probe-layer three-way parity harness. Read by BOTH Windows/Syxx.Tests/ProbeParityReplayTests.cs and macOS/Tests/SyxxKitTests/ProbeParityReplayTests.swift. Status strings are Swift DNSResponseStatus rawValues (camelCase); the C# loader normalizes onto its PascalCase enum. Each vector is a REAL capture or a content-free honest state; NEVER a synthetic mock. 'expected' is produced by the real evaluate() at capture time and must match on every platform.
_schema: probe-parity fixture v1 (WS-B5). VantageComparer.evaluate tri-state replay.

vectors.description: A local query was answered by a transparent on-path :53 interceptor with an answer that overlaps the public consensus. Contract: an answer overlapping the public union is AGREE (no redirection) — evaluate() must not cry wolf on a non-rewriting interceptor; a rewriting one is caught by the B010 DoH cross-check.
vectors.provenance: REAL capture via DNSResolver.queryUDPDetailed on macOS. Local leg pointed at 192.0.2.1 (TEST-NET-1, RFC 5737, unroutable). This capture network transparently intercepts outbound UDP/53 and answered with example.com's real Cloudflare IPs; the public legs are live answers from 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8 / 9.9.9.9.

vectors.description: The local resolver leg timed out (no response) while the three public baselines answered. Contract: a timeout is INCONCLUSIVE, never collapsed to a clean 'no redirection' verdict.
vectors.provenance: Local leg is the content-free timeout state (a timeout carries zero response bytes: {status: timeout, records: []}). Public legs are REAL live captures from 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8 / 9.9.9.9 for example.com. No fabricated record content.

vectors.description: Every leg timed out (a fully UDP/53-blocked network). Contract: no baseline and a timed-out local leg is INCONCLUSIVE, never clean.
vectors.provenance: Content-free honest state: a timeout carries zero response bytes, so every outcome is {status: timeout, records: []}. Reproducible on any network that blocks UDP/53; no fabricated record content.
